'Advanced Remote Sensing'
The course will introduce some of the most innovative advances in Remote Sensing that are particularly relevant to geographic studies with a variety of topics in biogeography, geospatial analysis, environmental studies, land use/land cover change, and urban studies. The Remote Sensing advances may cover the cutting-edge literatures in time series remote sensing, quantitative remote sensing, imagery fusion, AI/machine learning in remote sensing applications, image classification and segmentation, remotely sensed data assimilation, and advanced environmental applications.
